quarantine_note: v0.5 merge review (2026-09-21): gemv_splitk4 is QUARANTINED — UNSAFE_HISTORICAL_EXPERIMENT / REJECTED / NOT_FOR_NORMAL_DISPATCH. Reason: the process-level static workspace `static at::Tensor g_splitk_partials` (kernels/gemv/gemv_splitk4.cu) is shared by all calls — concurrent multi-stream / multi-thread use races on the same buffer (one call's combine can read another call's partials), and the workspace stays on the device of the FIRST call, so later calls on another device get a workspace on the wrong device. The kernel is scalar (no pointer-alignment contract; only the K%4==0 segment contract), so the static workspace provides no correctness or performance benefit, and the GEMV-0004 decision is REJECT (median speedup 0.878 < 1) — the variant is never a normal dispatch target. Disposition: removed from ext.variants() and from all normal CLI test/benchmark/optimize/profile paths (quarantined_set in kernels/gemv/bindings.cpp; explicit error names it); explicit forward/forward_into("gemv_splitk4", ...) remains a controlled historical-audit entry (single stream / single device / single thread). Source file, this experiment record, and all bench / NCU history are preserved unchanged. All numbers in this file remain valid as the single-stream single-device harness evidence they were measured as.
